ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is an isohyet distribution map of a certain country in the rainy season, marking rivers, national boundaries, and multiple isohyets. The isohyet where ① is located is positioned relatively toward the western inland area; the isohyet where ② is located is in the transition area in the middle of the figure; the isohyet where ③ is located is closer to the northeast and the southeast, near the humid edge around the Bay of Bengal. Then reason: Judging along the direction in the figure from the western inland area toward the humid coastal areas in the northeast or southeast, one will pass through the three isohyets ①, ②, and ③ in sequence. The values of isohyets change continuously along the precipitation gradient, and precipitation increases in this direction, so ③ corresponds to the largest precipitation, ② is next, and ① is the smallest. The order from large to small is ③②①, namely 321.
